questions.text: On a typical day, how many servings of fruits and vegetables do you eat? (1 serving = 80g / half a cup)
questions.source: OMICS Introductory Report; WHO Global Diet Strategy; PREDIMED

questions.text: How would you rate your usual daily fiber intake (whole grains, legumes, vegetables, fruit)?

High — daily whole grains, legumes, nuts, plenty of vegetables
